newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes lower in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes lower in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed 1.18 percent lower in thin trade on Monday, bourse sources said.
The 30-share index fell to 549.86 from 556.41 on Friday.
Coke bottler SFBT dropped by 2.7 dinars to 87.3 dinars. Amen Bank was down 1.85 dinars to 59.8. Airline Tunis Air fell 0.23 dinar to 15.63.
Retail stores Monoprix rose 0.98 dinar to 33.98. BDET bank was up 0.38 dinar to 16.7.
